notes.1: Many candidates appreciated that excretion, sensitivity, and reproduction are characteristics of all animals and all plants. Some candidates incorrectly believed that these are characteristics of animals only. Questions 3 Few candidates knew that the features that are characteristic of all arthropods are jointed legs and a segmented body.
notes.4: Only a minority of candidates knew that a bacterium has a cell wall.
notes.6: A large proportion of candidates incorrectly chose transpiration as the process by which oxygen passes out of a leaf. The process involved is diffusion.
notes.7: Few gave the correct response, suggesting that the process of osmosis was not fully understood by many candidates.
notes.9: Most candidates did not respond correctly. In trying to identify the correct option, candidates needed to identify the appropriate results for the Benedict’s solution, iodine solution and biuret tests, which are blue, brown, and purple, respectively.
notes.10: Most candidates chose either catalysts are not changed by the reaction (correct), or catalysts are broken down in the reaction (incorrect).
notes.11: While many candidates correctly identified the active site of the enzyme, some candidates incorrectly believed that the substrate was the active site.
notes.12: Some candidates did not appreciate that the test-tube containing the most oxygen would be the one with the aquatic plant on its own in the light, as oxygen would be released during photosynthesis.
notes.15: There was some uncertainty about which structure is part of the small intestine, as few identified the ileum.
notes.17: Only a minority of candidates appreciated that the red stain will be found in the xylem, tissue M.
notes.18: Some candidates understood that evaporation of water occurs at the surface of mesophyll cells and that diffusion of water vapour occurs through the stomata.
notes.19: The right ventricle was incorrectly identified by most candidates.
notes.20: Only a small proportion of candidates were able to correctly identify the correct order that red blood cells flow through blood vessels in the human body when travelling from the aorta to the right atrium of the heart. The key is 1 → 3 → 2 (arteries → capillaries → veins).
notes.21: Many candidates knew the correct characteristics of the skin in animals where gas exchange occurs through the skin. Some candidates incorrectly believed that the surface area of the skin would be small.
notes.22: Only a minority of candidates were able to correctly identify the direction of movement of gases. Some candidates incorrectly believed that the air entering the alveolus from the bronchiole only contains oxygen.
notes.23: Many candidates opted correctly, although some candidates confused what happens in photosynthesis with aerobic respiration.
notes.24: Many candidates correctly identified alcohol as the product of anaerobic respiration in yeast. Some candidates incorrectly opted for glucose.
notes.25: While many candidates correctly identified the urethra on the diagram, some candidates mistakenly thought the bladder was the urethra.
notes.27: Few candidates were able to correctly identify the stigma and anther on a wind-pollinated flower.
notes.28: Some candidates understood that fertilisation is when a pollen nucleus fuses with the nucleus in an ovule. Some candidates incorrectly believed that this process is pollination.
notes.30: Many candidates were aware that the organism that causes AIDS is a virus. Some candidates incorrectly believed that the organism is a bacterium.
notes.31: This proved to a challenging question with few selecting the correct option. All options were given equally by candidates suggesting a lack of understanding of this topic.
notes.33: Only a minority of candidates were aware that chromosomes are made of DNA.
notes.36: While many candidates understood that the energy being transferred along a food chain originally comes from the Sun, some candidates incorrectly selected the producer.
notes.38: Few candidates were able to identify the carnivores in a pyramid of biomass. Some candidates incorrectly chose the producers and primary consumers (herbivores).
notes.40: Many candidates understood that a reason for using bacteria in biotechnology is that they can make complex molecules. Some candidates incorrectly believed that it is because bacteria are found inside the human body.
notes.general_comments: There was good understanding of: the features of active transport; the components of the diet that can be broken down to release energy and interpreting tropic responses. There was some uncertainty about: the processes involved in transpiration in plant leaves; identifying the right ventricle of the heart and the order which red blood cells flow through blood vessels in the human body.
